clips.title: The story
paras: At Stonefield Farm in western Elwynn, Ma Stonefield tends to hardships close to home. Beside Auntie Bernice, she faces farm troubles, neighboring rivalries, and pests.

Ma Stonefield watches over the farm beside her family cottage in southwestern Elwynn Forest, with Auntie Bernice Stonefield at her side. The neighboring Maclure homestead and nearby pumpkin patches bring little peace. Wild boars threaten the Stonefield crops, and Princess causes the greatest trouble. The enormous prize sow tramples fields and devours the harvest the family worked hard to grow.
